name: LL-37

definition: LL-37 is a linear synthetic peptide supplied as both lyophilized powder and sterile solution formats. The catalogue lists 3 pack sizes: 5 mg, 5 ml, 10 ml. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC); appearance differs by format (powder vs solution). Each kit contains 10 vials; minimum order quantity is 1 kit. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is LL-37 tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Each lot of LL-37 is analysed by HPLC for purity and by mass spectrometry for identity. The lot-specific certificate of analysis reports the measured purity, retention time, molecular mass and appearance. Catalogue purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC).

faq.question: How should LL-37 be stored?
faq.answer: This item ships in more than one format: keep lyophilized vials at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture, and keep solution vials at 2-8 °C without freezing. Follow the instructions printed on the certificate of analysis for each lot. This product is for laboratory research use only.

faq.answer: LL-37 is available in 3 configurations: 5 mg, 5 ml, 10 ml. Each kit contains 10 vials. Minimum order quantity is 1 kit. Volume pricing applies to 10-49 kits and 50+ kits.
